metadata.name: perf-scroll-ancestor
metadata.description: Perf interaction helper: walk up from a target element to its nearest scrollable ancestor and scroll it. Use it when the scroll-parent of a virtualized list isn't the element you started from.

labels.parameters_json: [{"name":"selector","type":"string","required":true,"description":"CSS selector of the element inside the scrollable region (use a literal [data-testid=...]; @selector tokens do not resolve on the capture path)"},{"name":"deltaY","type":"number","required":false,"default":600,"description":"Vertical scroll delta in pixels"}]

evaluate.expression: (() => { let el = document.querySelector("${@params/selector}"); const dy = Number("${@params/deltaY}") || 600; while (el && el !== document.body) { const cs = getComputedStyle(el); if ((cs.overflowY === 'auto' || cs.overflowY === 'scroll') && el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight) { el.scrollBy(0, dy); return true; } el = el.parentElement; } window.scrollBy(0, dy); return false; })()
